To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Laser welding process induces high thermomechanical strain in the Laser module.

• Laser sub-mounts are very sensitive to the laser welding process • The laser submount is the most sensitive component to thermal cycles • The laser sub-mount is the most sensitive to the laser diode welding process.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of Laser submounts for Laser diode modules.
the development of high bandwidth, high reliability, low consumption and low cost optoelectronic packaging.
a better understanding of the Laser welding process and the influence of this process on Laser modules reliability.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Laser welding technology is the most suitable for packaging high reliability optical systems, especially for high power laser diodes.
the FEM simulations are a very useful tool for the design, development and optimization of the laser welding process.
the Laser welding process can be considered as an effective technique for the assembly and the hermeticity of Laser diodes in the optical submount.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the FEM simulation is a very useful tool for the analysis and design of the Laser diode module.
the FEM simulation is an efficient tool to predict the optical axis shift and the gradual drop of the output power due to the Laser welding process.
the Laser welding process is an efficient way to assemble Laser diodes on Laser submounts.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to predict the optical performance of a Laser module using the finite element method.
the use of the FEM to predict the mechanical behaviour of optoelectric devices is a very useful tool to improve the reliability and the robustness of such systems.
the use of a laser welding process for the assembly of optoelectronics modules induces high level of thermomechanics stress and strain in the submount and consequently in the laser diode.
